name: Feeder Centres
summary: The widest part of the pyramid. Every child who touches a ball at one of our feeder centres or community programmes is a possibility worth watching.
objectives: Football as habit, discipline and joy
progression: Standout players identified for Intermediate Centre trials

name: Intermediate Centres
summary: Where promise becomes a pathway. Players train under AFA-certified coaches, many for the first time under a formal development contract.
progression: Top performers scouted for the Centre of Excellence

name: Centre of Excellence
summary: Where India meets the world. Full-time coaching, sports science, education and international exposure inside our flagship Centre of Excellence.
objectives: International exposure across South America, Africa, Europe and North America
evaluation: Individual player report cards & scouting profiles
progression: Pathway to professional clubs in India and abroad
